title: PES 0110 writes a Lato Bold text as an editable CEmbNText object
description: design.export with pesVersion 11 writes a text as PE-DESIGN 11's CEmbNText with one CTTFLetter per character: the font (Lato), the size, Satin at 5.0 line/mm, the line not sewn, and the click point at the left end of the baseline. The design is the owner's r14 (tests/fixtures/pe11/PROVENANCE.md): AB in Lato Bold at the Text tool's defaults, size 10, clicked at (10,20) mm, in Red. PE-DESIGN stores no outlines: it lays the letters out again from the installed font, so the reference check is PE-DESIGN opening the file with the text editable and re-saving it: it does (retyping works), and keeps the object section but for the text box's right edge from its own layout.

evidence.note: docs/FILE_FORMATS.md, PES 0110 object list, CEmbNText: mapped from the owner's PE-DESIGN 11.50 text files (r12-r15, r23-r26, o-text-*, compat/reference/text/text-*); the writer rewrites all 18 byte-identical outside the documented differences, and builds r12's object section byte for byte from the letter defaults (pes11.rs)
PE-DESIGN 11.50 opening a.pes (MANIFEST pes-0110-editable-text, 2026-10-29): editable text AB, Lato 10, Satin red, retypable; the PES section re-saved unchanged but for the text box's right edge

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-0110-editable-text` and open target/compat/work/pes-0110-editable-text/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (App menu > Open), with Lato Bold installed as for the text references. Expected: the text AB as an editable text object, not a stitch pattern: Text tab shows font Lato, size 10.0, region Satin Stitch in 800 RED, line Not Sewn; the letters stand on the baseline y = 20 mm starting at x = 10 mm (status bar about 18,80 x 10,30 mm, as r14). Record in the MANIFEST notes: whether it opens and with what warning, whether the text can be retyped (Text tool on the object) and its attributes changed, its size and stitch count. Then Save As PES, default type (Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 File, #PES0110), unchanged, under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md). If PE-DESIGN refuses the file or opens it blank, do not add a file: write what you saw in the notes of docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md instead.
